Reconstructed ascending-pivot matching on augmented face poset: 96 pairs, four critical 2-faces and no others, all 588 Hasse edges oriented, all 196 nodes topologically sorted, so Forman gives wedge 4 S². Independently enumerated all 48 graph automorphisms, computed signed Lefschetz trace for every one via fixed faces, got χ(1)=4, χ(z)=-2, central z(i)=i+6. + eigenspace trace identically 1, − eigenspace dimension 3 and character square sum 48/48=1, proving absolutely irreducible over C. Rational invariant rank 1. The distance-3 graph equality with Franklin ordinary independence complex is an equivalent model and not treated as a separate novelty claim.
